title: Canonical strong monoidal structure on single cochain complexes
statement: Let C be a symmetric closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian category with additive tensor. Write s for the functor placing an object in degree zero in cochain complexes. Let c(L,M):s(L) tensor s(M) isomorphic to s(L tensor M) be the composite of map₂HomologicalComplexObjSingleIso and singleMapHomologicalComplex. There exists a strong monoidal structure on s whose tensorator is exactly c(L,M).hom for every L,M. This is a statement about the explicit tensor comparison, not a choice of an arbitrary monoidal structure. The ambient derived-tensor construction is [def-kun-derived-tensor], whose cochain tensor is used here.

source.place: Tags 06YQ (lemma-bounded-flat-K-flat) and 06YU (definition-derived-tor and signed symmetry immediately following it); degree-zero specialization of the canonical tensor localization.

proof.text: Define c by the two explicit single/bifunctor comparisons. Its inverse in degree zero is the inclusion of the (0,0) tensor summand. Naturality follows from the whisker/inclusion identities. Precompose the associator equation with the inverse double tensorators; the triple inclusion associator identity proves it. The degree-zero left and right unit inclusion identities prove both unit equations. Feed these isomorphisms and equations to CoreMonoidal.toMonoidal. Its tensorator is definitionally c.hom.

proof_origin.place: Canonical single-complex specialization of the tensor localization and its functorial comparison; expanded into the component argument above.

theorem exists_singleCochainMonoidal :
    ∃ m : (HomologicalComplex.single C (.up ℤ) 0).Monoidal,
      ∀ L M : C, letI := m
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (HomologicalComplex.single C (.up ℤ) 0) L M =
          (singleCochainTensorIso L M).hom
